description: This Java test class 'MediaHandlerTest' tests the MediaHandler class in the OpenMRS project. It focuses on verifying supported views and the behavior of saving observations with media content, including MIME type detection.

classes.name: MediaHandlerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying the behavior of MediaHandler, especially support for views and saving complex data associated with Obs entities.

methods.name: shouldReturnSupportedViews
methods.description: Test that the handler correctly returns the supported views array.

methods.name: shouldSupportRawView
methods.description: Test that the handler supports the RAW_VIEW.

methods.name: shouldNotSupportOtherViews
methods.description: Test that the handler does not support other views like HTML, PREVIEW, TEXT, TITLE, URI, null, and empty.

methods.name: saveObs_shouldRetrieveCorrectMimetype
methods.description: Test that saving an Obs with complex media data correctly sets the MIME type to 'audio/mpeg' after saving.
